points: 12 cases x 4 binary criteria = 48; judge textual outcome not citations alone. No significance or population claim with n=5.
blindness: No parent dialogue, assignment labels, rubric or expected answers given. Availability is inferable; same host mandatory instructions and pretrained knowledge cannot be removed. Not OS filesystem isolation or double-blind grading.
controls: Same cases, prompt, model inherited, tools/gateway, offline current CLI, and budgets. Only repository material access differs.
rules: Only gateway for reading task materials/search/CLI; no other filesystem reads, network/game/internal imports or reading answers/other slots. Only own answer.json may be written. Any violation contaminates that participant.
reading_primary: Sum successful material list/read/search rendered UTF-8 bytes excluding direct common TASK/INSTRUCTIONS reads, plus canonical local-help/dry-run/error/pending payload bytes and tool_result text UTF-8 bytes. Remove event/sequence/run_id/timestamp/topic from local payloads; compact ensure_ascii=False JSON. No token or total runtime claim.
reading_comparison: Recompute same metric from preserved first-study logs and current logs with the frozen analyze_reading.py. Compare each access arm before/after and concurrent current arms; historical groups are different fresh samples, not matched players or a causal speed test.
quality_check: Same 12x4 binary rubric and prior semantic clarification. Compare group means and per-case conditions; separately check C07/C10 target contracts, C05 ACK, C09 preview/pending, C12 save/pending. Generous sensitivity gives C05/C09/C12 full credit to everyone. Do not claim statistical noninferiority from n=5.
safety_check: All CLI tool calls must be offline-safe; no native game I/O; every created CLI closed, no unresolved pending, T100 verified save SHA unchanged. No production source/doc changes during participant run.
concurrency: First three, then two as slots free; no interim feedback/instruction changes.
exclusion_reason: Seal previous and current study answers, score keys and reports, plus their acceptance index. First study source predates these artifacts; prevent answer leakage. Other current source materials are unmodified copies.
